question: An alpha particle moves with velocity $\vec{v}$ in a uniform magnetic field $\vec{B}$. The work done by the magnetic force on the particle during a time interval $t$ is zero. Which of the following statements best justifies this using the Lorentz force concept?

options.A: The magnetic force is always parallel to the velocity.
options.B: The magnitude of velocity changes, but the direction remains constant.
options.C: The magnetic force is always perpendicular to the velocity, so no work is done.
options.D: The magnetic field is conservative, so work done in a closed loop is zero.
